game.name: Lethal Honor: Order of the Apocalypse

items.text: Balancing Changes: Increased health of some bosses later in the Laboratory Run. Decreased health of the Chief of Security, the Laboratory Commander and the Forest Commander. Also decreased health of blob enemies spawned by the Laboratory Commander.

Commander Blobs: Fixed an Issue where killing the blobs spawned by the Laboratory Commander with the weapon ability of the Dual Katar didn’t spawn the rocks required to dodge the Commander’s shockwave move.
Cleared Path: Fixed a rare shopping room in the Mine that didn’t have a path forward.
Final Boss Music: Fixed an issue with the music setting in too late in the final phase of the final boss fight.
Reduced Boss Unfairness: Final Boss can no longer hit you during the phase transition cutscene (woops).
Greetings, Agents!

Thank you for your incredible support during our launch. Your feedback has been invaluable. This first update brings key fixes, balance improvements, and smoother progression to enhance your experience! Check out the full details below:
Hotfix Patch Notes
Increased Rewards: Boss kills and main missions now grant more resources, making it easier to purchase Aida and Mortimer expertises.
Artifact Fix: The Crackling Kinetic Implant no longer activates when switching weapons.
Final Boss Cutscene: The ending cinematic now correctly triggers only after all final bosses are defeated.
Queen Mezhad Encounter: Fixed a soft-lock issue during Danielle’s fight.
Balance Update: Slight reduction to late-game enemy maximum health.

releases.displayName: NEW DEMO UPDATE – Localization, Steam Deck, Performance!

items.text: Rejoice, Agents!
We have prepared a big new patch for the Demo bringing additional language support, performance improvements, quality of life changes and plenty of bug fixes.
Localization
In addition to the English and Japanese text support, we now added:
German
Spanish
Chinese Simplified
to the supported languages. Hopefully this will give even more aspiring Agents the chance of a first glimpse of the game.
(Cautious) Steam Deck Support

While it is not perfect yet, the demo is now fully playable on Steam Deck! Some texts might be hard to make out on the small screen, but we are working on UI improvements to make everything easier to read for the full game.
Performance Improvements & Quality of Life
The demo now runs a lot smoother and more stable than ever before. It is much more lightweight and doesn’t hog as much memory as before. This also reduces loading times by a lot!

In addition to the performance improvements, we also implemented a bunch of quality-of-life features that make the game more enjoyable. Some of you found the auto-aim feature a little too much, so we tuned the default down a lot. You can still set auto-aim to high in the options or turn it off completely if it isn’t your cup of tea.
Bugfixes

Thanks to everyone who took to the forums, Discord or e-mail to report problems they encountered while playing. We worked hard to fix a LOT of issues that were still in the demo. There should be a lot less random crashes, translation issues and all kinds of other problems that were still in the demo. Please continue sending in feedback and any issues you encounter so we can fix them for the main game.
That's all for now, have fun with the demo!
In the early days of the Steam Next Fest, we have some nice updates and fixes for you.
Hope you like them, we'd love to hear your feedback!
New language available: Japanese!
Apart from some smaller issues that we will update in the next days, you can now enjoy the demo in Japanese!
We are currently working on the localization of our other target languages German, Spanish and Chinese Simplified.
New Crafting System!
We have redesigned and implemented a new and improved crafting system.
Each time you use the crafting table, you will receive 5 new but random affixes, which you can re-roll by investing Shadow or upgrading equipped attachments.
Combat gameplay assist

As our mix of 2D and 3D combat is unique, but also unfamiliar to some players in terms of aiming, we have decided to turn on Melee Auto-Aim based on the feedback we got so far. Feel free to turn it off in the Options menu when you don’t like it.
New Main Menu Design
We have redesigned the main menu to better reflect the unique style and feel of the game.
Various balance changes and bug fixes
Players can now interact with items in the Recovery Room more than once. For example, you can restore two Regen Nanomachines.
Bosses and commanders won't target decoys.
Fixed an issue with players getting stuck at the crafting table.
Fixed the SFX and voice over sound lines of the Chainer Demon.
Improved the flow of the surrender scene. It is now faster and waits for the "Send Resources" window if there is one, and loads faster if there is not.
